Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Object, o As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("a", "b", "c")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array(1, 2, 3)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array(4, 5, 6)
    ws.Range("A4:C4").Value = Array(7, 8, 9)
    ws.Range("A5:C5").Value = Array(10, 11, 12)
    Set o = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:C5"), , xlYes)
    o.Name = "T"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        
    Case 1
        o.TableStyle = ""
    Case 2
        o.ShowTotals = True
    Case 3
        o.ShowTableStyleRowStripes = False
    Case 4
        o.ShowTableStyleColumnStripes = True
    Case 5
        o.ShowTableStyleFirstColumn = True
    Case 6
        o.ShowTableStyleLastColumn = True
    Case 7
        o.ShowHeaders = False
    Case 8
        o.ShowAutoFilter = False
    Case 9
        o.ShowAutoFilterDropDown = False
    Case 10
        ws.Range("B2").Interior.Color = 255
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1").Font.Italic = True
    Case 12
        ws.Range("B3").Font.Color = 255
    Case 13
        ws.Range("C4").Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1:C5").NumberFormat = "0.00"
    Case 15
        ws.Range("E1").Formula = "=SUM(T[a])"
    Case 16
        ws.Range("E1").Formula = "=T[[#Headers],[a]]"
    Case 17
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=[@a]+1"
    Case 18
        ws.Range("E1").Formula = "=SUM(T)"
    Case 19
        ws.Range("E1").Formula = "=SUM(T[[a]:[b]])"
    Case 20
        ws.Range("E2").Formula = "=[@a]"
    Case 21
        ws.Range("E1").Formula = "=ROWS(T[#All])"
    Case 22
        o.Resize ws.Range("A1:A3")
    Case 23
        o.Resize ws.Range("A1:B2")
    Case 24
        o.Resize ws.Range("A1:C2"): o.TableStyle = "TableStyleLight1"
    Case 25
        o.TableStyle = "TableStyleLight15": o.Resize ws.Range("A1:B3")
    Case 26
        o.TableStyle = "TableStyleMedium9": o.ShowTotals = True: o.Resize ws.Range("A1:A4")
    Case 27
        ws.Range("A1:C5").Cut ws.Range("D3")
    Case 28
        ws.Range("B2").Font.Bold = False
    Case 29
        ws.Range("A1").Font.Bold = False
    Case 30
        ws.Range("A1").Font.Color = 0
    Case 31
        ws.Range("A3").Interior.Pattern = xlNone
    Case 32
        ws.Range("B2").Interior.Pattern = xlNone
    Case 33
        ws.Range("A2").Borders(xlEdgeTop).LineStyle = xlNone
    Case 34
        ws.Range("A1").Style = "Good"
    Case 35
        o.Range.AutoFilter 1, ">1"
    Case 36
        o.Range.Sort ws.Range("A1"), xlDescending, Header:=xlYes
    Case 37
        o.ListColumns.Add
    Case 38
        o.ListRows.Add
    Case 39
        o.Resize ws.Range("A1:D7")
    Case 40
        ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart.SetSourceData o.Range
    End Select
    o.Unlist
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Font.Bold
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Font.Color
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Interior.Color
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Interior.Pattern
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A2").Interior.Color
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A3").Interior.Color
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A3").Interior.Pattern
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A3").Interior.ThemeColor
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A3").Interior.TintAndShade
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Borders(xlEdgeBottom).LineStyle
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A2").Borders(xlEdgeTop).LineStyle
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.AutoFilterMode
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("E1").Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("C2").Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").ListObject Is Nothing
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Names.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Names.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Err.Number
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(ws.Range("A1").Style)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("A1").Style.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
